items.headline: Control of Congress is up for grabs. What's the math for Democrats and Republicans?
items.detail: Republicans currently hold majorities in the House and Senate. How many seats must Hakeem Jeffries and Chuck Schumer flip to seize control of Congress?

items.headline: Abortion is on the ballot in Missouri again. Here's what to know about Amendment 3
items.detail: Just two years after Missouri voters approved an amendment enshrining the right to abortion care in the state constitution, abortion is on the ballot again.

items.headline: Jay-Z announced as Super Bowl LXI halftime show performer
items.detail: Jay-Z is taking the Super Bowl LXI halftime stage. Super Bowl LXI will take place on Sunday, Feb. 14, 2027, at SoFi Stadium in Inglewood, California.

items.headline: WATCH: Dangerous king tides hitting both coasts
items.detail: Coastal flood alerts have been issued, with dangerous surf, beach erosion and 40 mph wind gusts possible.
